title: Promote live gVisor coverage safely
summary: Live boundary coverage tracks opt-in gVisor dispatch, but promotion needs explicit prerequisites, skipped-gate semantics, and mutation-edge coverage expansion that does not break non-Linux contributors.
expectedFailureModes: Live coverage validation passes while required gVisor prerequisites are absent in CI.
Unsupported local platforms are reported as regressions instead of documented skips.
Mutation-edge tests expand without recording the policy boundary they enforce.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before requiring Linux gVisor live tests on every CI run.
nextAction: Add live coverage metadata for Linux gVisor CI promotion prerequisites and a validation check that distinguishes unsupported hosts from real live-test failures.
